content: Purchase invoice. Voucher type purchase. Bill-wise new ref is the invoice number.
Debit note. Voucher type debit note. Bill-wise new ref is the debit note number.
Credit note. Voucher type credit note. Bill-wise new ref is the credit note number.
Same state: when the vendor state equals the client GSTIN state, use CGST and SGST input ledgers. Intra-state is not a tax rate.
Different state: use the IGST input ledger. Inter-state is not a tax rate.
GST 0%. Rate only. Intra versus inter is a separate rule.
GST 5%. Rate only. Intra versus inter is a separate rule.
GST 12%. Rate only. Intra versus inter is a separate rule.
GST 18%. Rate only. Intra versus inter is a separate rule.
GST 28%. Rate only. Intra versus inter is a separate rule.
SAC 9982. Legal and accounting advisory. GST 18%. Expense hint: Professional Fees. TDS hint: 194J when the firm's tds_sections include 194J. Matches the 194J golden.
SAC 9983. Other professional, technical and business services. GST 18%. Expense hint: Professional Fees. TDS hint: 194J when the firm's tds_sections include 194J.
SAC 9987. Maintenance and repair. GST 18%. Expense hint: Repairs and Maintenance. Matches the intra-state golden (HSN 9987).
HSN 8471. Computers. Expense hint: Purchases. Matches the fixture laptop line.
HSN 8528. Monitors. Expense hint: Purchases. Matches the fixture monitor line.
HSN 7208. Flat-rolled iron or steel. Expense hint: Purchase — raw material. Matches the platform coil fixture.
TDS section 194C. Contractor. Hint ledger: TDS payable 194C.
TDS section 194I. Rent. Hint ledger: TDS payable 194I.
